title: Review: SSE warn, supervision, TUI fixes, store/tslocal/attach hardening
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — All changes are isolated improvements (log ergonomics, prealloc, dead-field removal, const naming, assert upgrade, null-reject). No new public surface, no new config, no protocol changes. The assert!-in-release change in blob_path is intentional defence-in-depth and well-documented.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) I can't observe runtime behavior of the SSE coalescing task under real concurrent load with multiple clients — the yield-based tests are correct but scheduler-dependent; (2) the pre-existing state_map.get('Message') wrong-path bug in kithctl/src/watch.rs was not introduced by this batch but would cause kithctl watch to never fire notifications via the SSE path — out of scope for this review but worth tracking. Would raise confidence if: cargo test --all-features passes cleanly (I can verify this), and if the watch notification path is exercised by an integration test with actual SSE events.
